description: One record per SEEK Australia or New Zealand job. Records include the job title, company, structured location, work types and arrangements, classification, salary label plus parsed salary fields, posting and expiry dates, the full description, contacts when the ad publishes them, company-profile details, applicant counts and search provenance. Fields SEEK does not provide are omitted rather than sent as empty values.

jobs.description: Dataset containing every scraped SEEK job record, one JSON object per job.
jobs.title: SEEK job records
